title: Construction Invoice and Expense Exceptions: Missing Cost Codes, Duplicate Receipts, and Unapproved Work
summary: Define the exception decisions a construction finance Genie must escalate instead of hiding them behind a confident match.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A construction finance Genie needs explicit exception rules for ambiguous job coding, duplicate documents, arithmetic differences and unapproved work. Each exception should identify the affected lines, supporting evidence, decision owner and allowed next step. Keep detection separate from resolution: the agent can identify two similar receipts or a missing approval, but that does not authorize deleting a document, choosing a cost code, or approving additional work.
